limitations: Bypasses intervene on a model trained with both IRP paths; they are not retrained ablations.
Per-GT raw oracles reuse predictions across GT and do not implement official one-to-one matching.
Pre-NMS top500 is diagnostic and is not the model's post-NMS max_det=500.
Original-image area bins in raw_oracle are diagnostic, not official VisDrone scale AP.
